column1: # pos: NOUN VERB ADJ ADV CONJ PREP ART PRON (the six core categories plus articles and pronouns) (pipe-separated for multi-POS)
#   For a NOUN: the kind of thing it is. For a VERB: the subject kinds it
#   plausibly takes. Sparse by design — untagged means "no opinion" for the
#   tags the common/uncommon nouns and verbs only; rare/legendary and
#   adjectives/adverbs are left for a later content pass.
# weight (optional): how often the word surfaces
#   category. Independent of tier — tier is what a word is *worth*
#   how often you *see* it. Omitted means 1.0. Mainly for function words
#   real usage is wildly uneven ("the" vs "every").
# Weighted by real usage. With all ten equally likely the determiner slot was
# spread so thin that "the" landed on ~6% of spins
# instead of "The friend ate". "the" and "a" carry most of English; the
# possessives and demonstratives are flavour and stay rare.
